review.reason: The change introduces new TypeScript interfaces and an API method to fetch section-specific counts, and refactors the desktop inbox badge to use a shared request. This represents a substantive, bounded implementation of a new capability and a corresponding UI behavior change. observations.behavior: Adds SignalReportSectionCounts and SignalReportSectionCountsParams interfaces, including pull_requests and reports counts.
